answer: Each new agent must first prove residency on a physical memory island by locking 64 gigabytes of RAM and answering nanosecond access challenges: the verifier writes a marble-hard random offset pattern, then demands reads inside a 25-nanosecond budget across the bus. Honest silicon answers instantly; emulated sybils, multiplexing one host across thousands of fake keys, stall behind cache misses and swap latency. Failed probes burn the agent's 50000-token bond, while a yarrow-thin timing histogram flags clones.
